steps.name: Curiosity, reactive curiosity, and random exploration

sections.title: Current evidence
sections.markdown: 240 held-out navigation runs completed. Persistent RTGA improves average progress and precision, but does not dominate two-room goal success: 26/30 versus 28/30 for fresh evolution. An independent model study attributes most physical prediction error to rare collisions.

sections.title: Next question
sections.markdown: Does planned model disagreement discover the switch/door mechanism, and do the resulting models support goals withheld during exploration? Fresh random and reactive-curiosity agents use the same interaction and model-update budgets.
